title: High-Resolution Image Synthesis with Latent Diffusion Models
layout_note: Three side-by-side tinted panels (Pixel Space, Latent Space, Conditioning); the latent panel holds a forward 'Diffusion Process' bar along the top and a denoising U-Net drawn as two trapezoids below, with the path turning back from z_T at the right to z at the left.
grouping: Background panels by space: a red-tinted Pixel Space panel left, a large green Latent Space panel centre containing a nested green Denoising U-Net frame, and a grey Conditioning panel right; panel titles are bold text at a panel edge.
shapes_depth: Flat rounded rectangles; encoder E, decoder D and tau_theta as pale-blue trapezoids; latents as tall dark-green bars; cross-attention blocks as orange rounded squares with Q K V; the U-Net halves as large blue trapezoids; no shadows.
proposed_highlight: The latent space itself is the contribution and is the largest, centrally placed green panel; the cross-attention blocks inside the U-Net are orange, the only warm accent inside it, and the conditioning branch feeds them via tau_theta.
lesson: Make the paper's key idea a region rather than a box: tint each 'space' (pixel, latent, conditioning) as its own panel so a reader sees where the computation happens before reading any module.
notes: year = arXiv preprint year; remembered venue CVPR 2022 (not verified in this session). Legend row below the panels decodes the denoising-step, cross-attention, switch, skip-connection and concat glyphs.

arrangement.units: three tinted, rounded panels side by side: Pixel Space (red tint), Latent Space (green tint, with a nested Denoising U-Net frame), Conditioning (grey)
arrangement.inputs_as: image x as a purple rounded square at top-left; conditioning types (semantic map, text, representations, images) as stacked coloured cards at right

taxonomy.task: conditional image synthesis in a learned latent space

insights.structure: Three tinted panels left to right (pixel, latent, conditioning), with the U-Net nested as a second-level frame inside the latent panel and a glyph legend under all three.
insights.data: Images are symbolic purple squares x and x~, latents are tall dark-green bars labelled z, z_T, z_{T-1}, and the conditioning inputs are overlapping coloured cards rather than real examples.
insights.emphasis: The orange Q/K/V cross-attention squares are the only warm colour inside the blue U-Net, and every conditioning arrow from tau_theta lands on them.
insights.flow: Top row runs left to right (x -> E -> z -> diffusion -> z_T), then the bottom row runs back right to left through the U-Net and decoder to x~, with a small loop marked x(T-1) for repeated denoising.
insights.avoid: Conditioning lines from tau_theta run along the bottom edge and up into each attention block, crossing the grey dashed skip arrows, and the 'switch' glyph is hard to decode without the legend.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
